titleSq: Lokal në shitje në Fushë Kosovë
titleEn: Commercial unit for sale in Fushë Kosovë
descriptionSq: Ofrohet per shitje lokali me siperfaqe rreth 500 m², me lokacion ne Rrugen Nene Tereza, Fushe Kosove.
Lokali ka qasje direkte ne rruge dhe ka nje hapesire te brendshme te hapur, ne katin perdhese.
I pajisur me flete poseduese dhe kontrata behet tek noteri.
Lokali ndodhet ne nje zone mjaft te zhvilluar dhe ne aferesi me te gjitha sherbimet e nevojshme per zhvillimin e veprimtarive biznesore.
Lokali ka qira aktive me kontrate afatgjate, me te ardhura mujore 3500 Euro.
descriptionEn: Commercial unit for sale with an area of about 500 m², located on Rruga Nene Tereza, Fushë Kosovë.
The unit has direct road access and has an open interior space, on the ground floor.
It comes with an ownership certificate and the contract is signed at the notary.
The unit is located in a well-developed area, near all the services needed for running business activities.
The unit has an active lease with a long-term contract, with a monthly income of 3500 Euro.
